The '''''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought''', also known as the '''''Assertor''-class Command Dreadnought''' and '''''Assertor''-class dreadnought''',<ref name="Lead by Example" /> was a class of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]<ref name="EGWFB1">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=photo.php?fbid=10150717011498713|name=Star Wars Books|date=2012-03-31|archivedate=20210423184732}}</ref> [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="EGW" /> The [[Wrath (Assertor-class)/Legends|''Wrath'']] belonged to this class.

==Description==
===Dimensions===
[[File:ImperialFleetRefueling.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An ''Assertor'' dreadnought gets refueled by an [[Altor-class replenishment ship|''Altor''-class replenishment ship]] alongside two [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]]  two [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and one [[Bellator-class dreadnought]].]]
The ''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought was 15 kilometers long<ref name="Jason Fry specs" /> and had a hull-shape similar to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]], being primarily shaped like an arrowhead.<ref name="EGW" /> It was considered the second largest of the standard Star Dreadnought line (with only the ''Executor''-class being larger), as well as the largest in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in a family that included the ''Mandator''- and ''Bellator''-class ships.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

The overall ship's hull was shaped like a long, thin arrowhead hull.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

On the top of the ship was a large, prominent ridge from the stern up to a few yards from the bow, containing several guns as well as the command bridge, slightly similar in appearance to the ridge of the [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-]] and [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnoughts]].<ref name="EGW" />

On the ventral side of the ''Assertor'' were located three ridges&mdash;one directly behind the reactor bulge and two to the sides facing the ship's bow.<ref name="I134" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
The class was equipped with a large amount of gun batteries mounted along the ridge of the ship, as well as the flat dorsal and ventral surfaces. Many of the batteries were positioned in patterned clusters.<ref name="EGW" /> Its armament of turbolasers, while less extensive in comparison to the ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts, were nonetheless powerful enough to devastate a planet, and was regarded as the second-most powerful dreadnought in the navy.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

===Propulsion systems===
The ''Assertor''-class was designed with 28 aft thrusters for propulsion<ref name="I134" /> and a hyperdrive for interstellar-range travel.<ref name="EGW" /> The main reactor jutted from the ventral side of the ship and was covered with armor plating, similar to the [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|SFS]] [[I-a2b solar ionization reactor/Legends|I-a2b solar ionization reactor]].<ref name="I134" />

===Bridge tower===
The ''Assertor''<nowiki></nowiki>'s T-shaped bridge tower was similar in appearance to many other [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] designs built during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="EGW" /> Because the ''Assertor'' was designed primarily for conventional fleet operations and [[Sector Command]] duties, the ship class is dotted with various sophisticated communications and sensor suites, and was also equipped with various command and control systems that allow its Commander a nearly unparalleled view of the battlefield.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

==History==
[[File:AptlyNamedWrath-EGW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Wrath'' led a Base Delta Zero.]]
The ''Assertor''-class served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] and a heavily armed weapons platform. In addition to this, it frequently acted as a sector command and control ship, and when in fleet formation was often flanked by dreadnoughts of the ''Mandator'' and ''Bellator'' class. At least two were built prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the lead ship ''[[Assertor/Legends|Assertor]]'', and the [[Wrath (Assertor-class)/Legends|''Wrath'']]. By the time of the Battle of Hoth, both the ''Assertor'' and the ''Wrath'' were deployed with large battle groups to provide support to anti-Rebel operations along the border between the Outer Rim and Mid Rim territories. These battlegroups were rumored to be composed of dozens of other ships, including various smaller dreadnoughts, cruiser-sized vessels, numerous vessels, and ''Imperial I''- and ''Imperial II''-class vessels.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

Two ''Assertor''-class ships were at one point serviced and refueled at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']] in the [[Validusia system/Legends|Validusia system]]. During a fleet exercise at some point after the [[Arms Race]] campaign,<ref name="Arms Race timeframe">Three [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s were seen flying in formation during the refilling procedure, which indicates that it took place after the [[Arms Race]] campaign shown in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], due to the TIE/ad starfighter entering the Imperial Navy after the events of that campaign.</ref> a ship of this class was refueled by an [[Altor-class replenishment ship|''Altor''-class replenishment ship]], simultaneously with an [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser]].<ref name="EGW" />

The ''Wrath'' led at least one [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] operation in its career. This dreadnought was in charge of a fleet consisting of [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-]] and [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]] and at least one [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]]. The fleet also had access to squadrons of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Less dark-side temple and terror weapon, more optimized for basic, 'conventional' fleet work against a growing New Republic.|Ansel Hsiao|<ref name="I134" />}}
[[File:Naval_Station_Validusia.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Several ''Assertor''-class ships docked at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']].]]
The ''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought originated as a [[fanon]] design by [[Ansel Hsiao]], envisioned as a 15-kilometer-long warship with power generation approximately equivalent to 400 [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="AHPSD1">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?p=3242676#p3242676|text=Something big|author=fractalsponge1|date=2010-10-02|work=[https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/index.php StarDestroyer.Net BBS]|archivedate=20200615214309}}</ref> In addition, it was also the largest 3D modelling project he had done at the time, requiring 30+ million polygons.<ref name="FractalSponge">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/3D%20Projects.htm|text=3D Projects: Past, Present, and Future|archivedate=20200116164039}}</ref> He based the design on a real-life antecedent: in the early 1900s, Senator [[Wikipedia:Benjamin Tillman|Benjamin Tillman]], tired of the U.S. Navy's practice of annually requesting slightly bigger battleships, simply told them to design "[[Wikipedia:Maximum battleship|maximum battleships]]," the largest battleships possible that were only limited by their ability to cross the [[Wikipedia:Panama Canal|Panama Canal]]. The artist envisioned it as a more practical dreadnought design meant to combat the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="I134" />

[[File:AssertorModel-Fractalsponge.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ansel Hsiao's model]]
The design [[List of fanon elements in continuity|entered continuity]] when it appeared in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', on which Ansel worked as an illustrator. [[Jason Fry]], author of ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', confirmed that the length and classification of the ''Assertor''-class were recorded in [[Canon|official continuity]] in his blog,<ref name="Jason Fry specs" /> but stated on the forums at [[TheForce.net]] that any power calculations or other info not mentioned in the endnotes were not necessarily canon.<ref name="JCF">
{{JCFCite|temp=yes|url=posts/102539|board=Expanded Universe|thread=Lit - BE EXCITED: The Essential Thread to The Essential Guide to Warfare|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2012-05-14|nobackup=1}}</ref>

The ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', when discussing the Super Star Destroyers, erroneously depicted the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] as an ''Assertor''-class instead of the ''Executor''-class.

Ansel Hsiao's original design also included an [[Axial superlaser/Legends|axial superlaser]], which is visible in renderings; however, the superlaser was not included in any official source material.
